text:
3-5-99

Dear Sir:

I am writing to R. G. Reynolds because I don’t know what else to do. I truly hope you can help!

My name is Claryetta Dillon Brown, my husband is Charles Spencer Brown. We were married in 1972, so we will be celebrating our 27th anniversary this year.

But what does this have to do with you guys? Well, we have been smoking ALMOST as long as we’ve been married! I myself started smoking in 1974; my sister-in-law smoked Winston 100’s, and since I was staying with her while Charles was in the service, I started smoking her cigarettes. I have smoked Winston 100’s ever since. This is my 25th anniversary year of smoking! I have thoroughly enjoyed smoking all these years and I just can’t imagine NOT smoking! I still enjoy it tremendously.

Charles has been smoking since before we were married. He mostly smoked Camel 100’s filters, actually almost all of our lives. He has smoked them once or twice switching to Kool Filters but always going back to the non-filter Camels.

Five years ago, he had to have a quadruple bypass clogged arteries in his heart. Since then he has switched to Camel Filters.
